name: Figgins Cuts 1834
designer: Individual engravers unidentified in the specimen
description: Pictorial cuts, engraved emblems, decorative frames, labels and pointing hands from the 1834 V. Figgins specimen.
observed: 143 complete historical designs. Separate source settings, repeated impressions, compositions and matches to existing collection items are documented in the inventory.
reconstructed: No invented pictorial content. Recorded erasures exclude adjacent ink and captions. Small isolated scan specks are removed. Measured rotations and, for recorded rectangular frames, quadrilateral rectification correct scan geometry; uniform final scaling preserves proportions.
